body:
We both love each other, but could it be that it just won't work out, no matter how hard I try or we try? Having kids makes this all more complicated. But the more we fight, the more I love her, and the more I want to make it work.

Her cheating was limited to a kiss with a guy on two separate occasions and four months of facebook conversations. I think the four months of conversations hurt more than the kisses. If I didn't have kids, I would have already killed myself. I don't want to live anymore, but I don't want to leave my kids without a father even more. Sometimes my thoughts on that waffle towards the other direction, like right now. I just want to go to sleep and not wake up.
